  "content": "# QA Lessons Learned\n\nUse these concrete subtasks in the repaired template, adapting wording as needed:\n- Acquire the daily media-processing lock before reading or writing chunk transcripts.\n- Enumerate all media files from the target day and record the expected count.\n- Skip only chunks with valid non-empty JSON transcripts; corrupted JSON must be regenerated.\n- Transcribe missing chunks with the turbo transcription skill.\n- Validate transcript language against expected English, Mandarin, or Cantonese.\n- Merge chunk transcripts in chronological order.\n- Interpret the merged transcript into a concise briefing note.\n- Correct known calendar facts from user corrections before publishing.\n- Publish passive artifacts to the dashboard, not proactive chat during quiet hours.\n- Save local artifacts under durable workspace paths, not /tmp.\n- Clean up temporary chunk scratch files after successful artifact persistence.\n- Write a handoff with processed files, skipped files, failures, and next retry time.\n- QA must review, rearrange, and add subtasks from lessons learned on the template.\n- Verify the next recurring child inherits the repaired template.\n\nDo not include these lazy placeholders:\n- Execute the primary recurring workflow\n- done\n- cancel\n"
